lead.titleZh: 新冠后遗症干预：系统综述更新物理、心理和替代疗法有效性
lead.titleEn: Post-COVID Condition: Systematic Review Updates Efficacy of Physical, Psychological, and Alternative Interventions
lead.paragraphZh: 今天有 6 个条目，跨越 5 个专业方向，其中运动康复和心肺康复各有 1 条 curatedScore 75 的高分研究。最值得关注的是关于新冠后遗症干预的一项系统综述，它评估了物理、心理和替代疗法的有效性，这为临床实践提供了更全面的证据等级支持。另一项运动康复领域的观察研究，探讨了多模式恢复策略对足球比赛后神经肌肉恢复和炎症反应的影响。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's issue features 6 entries across 5 specialties, with two curatedScore 75 studies in Sports Rehabilitation and Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation. The most noteworthy is a systematic review on post-COVID condition interventions, evaluating the efficacy of physical, psychological, and alternative therapies, offering higher-level evidence for clinical practice. Separately, an observational study in sports rehabilitation examined multimodal recovery strategies' impact on neuromuscular restoration and inflammatory responses post-football match.

items.title: A multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy improves neuromuscular restoration and attenuates inflammatory and oxidative stress responses following a standardized football match: a randomized crossover study
items.summary: A randomized crossover study (n=20 male semi-professional football players) found that a modern multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy (very low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, percussive therapy) significantly improved neuromuscular restoration and attenuated inflammatory/oxidative stress markers post-match compared to passive recovery, with outcome-specific differences from traditional active recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，多模式非疲劳性恢复策略（如极低强度骑行、泡沫滚压和冲击疗法）比传统主动跑步或被动恢复更能支持短期神经肌肉恢复，并减轻足球比赛后的生化紊乱。您可以考虑将其整合到运动队的赛后恢复方案中。
items.titleZh: 多模式非疲劳性恢复策略在标准化足球比赛后改善神经肌肉恢复并减轻炎症和氧化应激反应：一项随机交叉研究
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉研究（20 名半专业男足球运动员）发现，现代多模式非疲劳性恢复策略（极低强度骑行、泡沫滚压、冲击疗法）与被动恢复相比，能显著改善赛后神经肌肉恢复并减轻炎症/氧化应激标志物，与传统主动恢复的差异则取决于具体结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that a multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy (e.g., very low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, and percussive therapy) may better support short-term neuromuscular recovery and attenuate biochemical disturbances after a football match compared to traditional active running or passive recovery. Consider integrating this into your sports teams' post-match recovery protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=20），且未前瞻性注册临床试验，部分结果在多模式与传统主动恢复间未显示持续性优势，需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=20), was not prospectively registered, and some results did not consistently show an advantage of multimodal over traditional active recovery, requiring cautious interpretation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: What’s Behind the Label? Rethinking Exercise Prescription for Tendinopathy - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: This BJSM blog post argues that exercise prescription for tendinopathy should move beyond generic labels (e.g., eccentric, isometric) to detailed documentation of the "mechanical dose," including actual load, effort, repetitions, tempo, range, and patient response, to improve clinical reasoning and reporting.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调，肌腱病变康复中，不应仅仅记录“离心、等长、慢速大负荷”等笼统的运动名称，而应详细记录实际负荷、次数、速度、范围和患者反应等具体“机械剂量”。这有助于您更精准地评估干预效果并调整方案。
items.titleZh: 标签背后是什么？重新思考肌腱病变的运动处方
items.summaryZh: 这篇 BJSM 博客文章认为，肌腱病变的运动处方应超越笼统的标签（如离心、等长），转向详细记录“机械剂量”，包括实际负荷、努力程度、重复次数、节奏、范围和患者反应，以改进临床推理和报告。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary emphasizes that in tendinopathy rehabilitation, you should not just record general exercise names like "eccentric, isometric, or heavy slow resistance," but rather detailed "mechanical doses" such as actual load, repetitions, speed, range, and patient response. This will help you more accurately evaluate intervention effectiveness and adjust treatment plans.

items.title: Development of a Communication Characteristics Module for Autistic Adults and the Creation of a Communication Profile Variable
items.summary: Researchers developed and validated a 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for autistic adults using a community-based participatory research approach. The module demonstrated high feasibility and strong construct validity, providing a valid tool for characterizing communication diversity in research, clinical, and service settings.
items.curatedReason: 我们现在有了一个经验证的10项沟通特征模块和五级沟通概况变量，用于评估自闭症成年人的沟通多样性。这有助于我们更精准地理解和描述自闭症成年人在不同情境下的沟通方式，而非仅仅停留在诊断层面。
items.titleZh: 自闭症成年人沟通特征模块的开发及沟通概况变量的创建
items.summaryZh: 研究人员采用社区参与式研究方法，开发并验证了一个包含 10 个项目的自闭症成年人沟通特征模块和一个五级沟通概况变量。该模块在可行性和结构效度方面表现出色，为研究、临床和服务环境中表征沟通多样性提供了有效工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: We now have a validated 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for assessing communication diversity in autistic adults. This tool will help us more precisely understand and describe the communication styles of autistic adults across various settings, moving beyond a sole diagnostic focus.
items.limitation: 本研究基于自闭症成年人的自我报告数据，可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on self-reported data from autistic adults, which may introduce reporting bias.

items.title: Fall prevention interventions among older adults in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs): an integrative review.
items.summary: An integrative review of 14 studies from LMICs found that multifactorial interventions, exercise-based programs, and home safety modifications were associated with reductions in fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults.
items.curatedReason: 在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），多因素干预、运动和家庭安全改造可降低老年人跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧。您在这些地区开展跌倒预防工作时，应将高收入国家经验进行本地化适应。
items.titleZh: 低收入和中等收入国家老年人跌倒预防干预措施：一项综合性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 14 项来自低收入和中等收入国家研究的综合性综述发现，多因素干预、运动方案和家庭安全改造与老年人跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧的降低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: In low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), multifactorial interventions, exercise, and home safety modifications can reduce fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults. When implementing fall prevention in these regions, you should adapt high-income country experiences to local contexts.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究数量有限（14 项），且干预措施和测量结局存在异质性，因此结论的普遍性和确定性受限。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (14) and heterogeneity in interventions and outcomes restrict the generalizability and certainty of the conclusions.

items.title:
Effectiveness of physical, psychological, and alternative interventions for post-COVID-19 condition: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 27 RCTs (1998 participants) found that supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise consistently improved cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in post-COVID-19 condition, while cognitive-behavioral therapy reduced fatigue. However, most trials had a high risk of bias.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动对改善新冠后遗症患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力有显著益处，认知行为疗法（CBT）也能有效减轻疲劳和注意力问题。您可以将这些干预措施纳入临床实践，但请注意许多研究的偏倚风险较高。
items.titleZh: 物理、心理和替代干预措施对新冠后遗症的有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项随机对照试验（1998 名参与者）的系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动持续改善了新冠后遗症患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力，而认知行为疗法则减轻了疲劳。然而，大多数试验存在高偏倚风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found significant benefits of supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise for improving cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in post-COVID-19 patients, with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) also effective in reducing fatigue and concentration issues. You can incorporate these interventions into clinical practice, but be aware of the high risk of bias in many studies.
items.limitation: 多数纳入研究存在高偏倚风险，样本量小且随访期短，且因异质性未能进行荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: Most included studies had a high risk of bias, small sample sizes, and short follow-up periods, and meta-analysis was not performed due to heterogeneity.
